title: Model Reliability & Accuracy
method: 5-fold cross-validation, 8 epochs per fold. Every photo was tested once by a model that had not seen it.
kappaMeaning: Almost perfect agreement (Landis & Koch scale). Kappa shows how much better the model is than guessing: 0 is chance, 1 is perfect.
caveat: These scores come from photos taken from the same collections the model learned from. Phone photos taken in your own garden may score lower, so treat low-confidence results with care.
